== Marginal cuts ==
Rewrite of [[Squadron Members]] to the style guide (Bill, via Chief, 14 October 2026). Cut from the article; full text is in the previous revision, [https://wiki.swccg.com/index.php?oldid=86854 86854].
* '''How the lists survive:''' the original GeoCities paths were geocities.com/plarathas/ and geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ (same site; the last homepage note on later mirrors is 15 August 2005). Wayback of the original home: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ 13 May 2001] (further captures 17 May, 26 May, 21 July 2001). That page links anagrams.html, names [[John Sarnecki]] as the former Squadron Member who started King of Corellia, and lists TDs [[Alex Alcalde]] (Gold 31), [[John Kaufeld]] and [[Craig Spaid]] (Bravo 36).
* Wayback of geocities.com/plarathas/SMs.html, [https://web.archive.org/web/20091028130457/http://geocities.com/plarathas/SMs.html 28 October 2009], is HTTP 410 (GeoCities already closed). Reocities anagrams copy used by Encyclopedia 3.2: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160406045459/http://www.reocities.com/CollegePark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Wayback 6 April 2016].
* The GeoCities page asked Squadron Members to help complete a set of black-border signed X-wings, Y-wings, Snowspeeders and Naboo Starfighters.
* [[Ming Huo]] described Squadron Members as "basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events" (Slack, 9 October 2026; kept as the citation).

== Possibly faulty data ==
* '''PC reprint vs GeoCities:''' same roster. The PC table has no Status column; GeoCities marks almost every filled slot Retired and notes four moves: [[Kyle Heuer]] Red 7 → Rogue Leader; [[Kevin Ch'ng]] Red 17 → Gold 13; [[Francis Lalumiere]] Red 23 → Gold 28; [[Guillermo Ruiz]] Gold 17 → Red 42 (each still listed in both squadrons). Red 3 is [[Jason Robinette]] on the PC page and "Jason R" on GeoCities. Red Leader is spelled "Jonathon" on both. Both share typos (Virgina, Gainsville, Hungry, Joel An=rendain, Mithc); the article links repaired titles and shows names as published where the canonical page differs (e.g. [[Christopher Solomon|Kit Soloman]], [[Cat Ceder|Cat Cedar]]).
* '''Vacant slots''' on both lists: Gold 10, 21–23, 25–26, 99–100; Red 9, 28–29, 75–76, 120; Bravo 22.
* '''Completeness:''' the GeoCities tribute called itself complete; [[Scott Lingrell]] says it is not (he was Rogue 60; the Rogue table ends at Rogue 40, [[Doug Faust]]). The archived decipher.com region listings (1999–2001) carry 176 callsign entries and sometimes give a different callsign or later hometown than the fan table; those differences are noted on each member's Talk page.
